description: identity.rs:172-181: serde_json::from_value(rt.clone()).ok() silently discards parse errors for replyTo and bcc on create. A client sending malformed replyTo (e.g. a string instead of Address[]) sees the field silently dropped and identity created without it. Should return invalidProperties instead of silent ignore — violates RFC 8621 §6.3 and principle of least surprise.
title: Identity/set create: malformed replyTo/bcc silently ignored
